suites.name: RIO_01
suites.title: RawIQR Origin Audit
suites.finding: rawIQR is a pure function of seed-determined weight sampling + N. Generator (uniform[0.90,1.10]) explains mean (bias=-0.23%). Between-seed variance dominates (ratio=0.097). Topology independent. Decision: Model A.

suites.name: SRA_01
suites.title: Seed Realization Structure Audit
suites.finding: rawIQR is a stable shared seed-level trait across N (cross-N r=0.90-0.95, C1). Between-seed variance=93.6%. Generator seed-reuse fully explains cross-N consistency. rawIQR independent from rawMean. Model A.

suites.name: SRP_01
suites.title: Seed-to-Selection Propagation Audit
suites.finding: Propagation unresolved due to sparse per-seed SAC retention (7 profiles from 5 seeds across 300 runs). IsHi rates similar across strata (43-48%). Seed→P1 r=0.007. SAC→P1 discrimination works at pooled level (V5.53) but not per-seed. Model F.

suites.name: SRX_01
suites.title: Sparse Retention Expansion Audit
suites.finding: 3x expansion (100→300 seeds) increases SAC-retained from 7 to 18 (R3: improved but underpowered). IsHi confirmed rawIQR-independent (45-49% across strata). Seed→P1 r=0.044 — no seed-level propagation. Pooled discriminator works; seed-level does not (P2). Model D.

suites.name: RLP_01
suites.title: RawIQR Local Profile Audit
suites.finding: rawIQR remains dominant P1/P1b discriminator after seed-centering (100% normalized delta, 3.2x rawMean). Residual rawIQR delta=-0.00105 survives seed matching. Only 10/300 seeds have mixed outcomes. Model A: local spread dominates.

suites.name: RPD_01
suites.title: RawIQR Profile Deviation Audit
suites.finding: Within-seed residual is N-driven (sample-size variation, |r|=0.101). Between-seed std 4.2x within-seed residual std. Residual separates P1/P1b (delta=-0.00105). Topology structurally independent. Model A.

suites.name: RPC_01
suites.title: RawIQR Residual Predicate Closure Audit
suites.finding: rIQR orthogonal to rMean (r=0.0000). rIQR P1-P1b delta=0.00105 (8.7x rMean). Residual composite degrades separation. rQ10/rQ90 weakly correlate (|r|~0.14). Same-seed same-N matching impossible. Model A.

suites.name: TSS_01
suites.title: V5.54 Final Synthesis
suites.finding: V5.54 COMPLETE. Model A+: Two-level rawIQR — seed-level (93.6%, SAC-irrelevant) and residual-level (6.4%, SAC-relevant). Residual rawIQR orthogonal to mean, dominates 8.7x. Pooled composite (V5.53) and residual discriminator (V5.54) are distinct layers.

finalModel: Model A+ — Two-level rawIQR structure: seed-level (93.6% variance, SAC-irrelevant) + residual-level (6.4% variance, SAC-relevant). Pooled composite (V5.53) ≠ residual discriminator (V5.54).
decisionModel: Model A+: Between-seed rawIQR (generator realization) dominates variance but does NOT propagate to P1. Within-seed residual (N-driven sampling) carries P1/P1b signal. Residual rawIQR orthogonal to residual rawMean (r=0.0000), dominates 8.7x.
primaryFinding: RawIQR variation originates from seed-determined random weight sampling from the uniform[0.90, 1.10] generator. The generator explains the mean rawIQR within 0.23% bias. Between-seed variance is ~10x larger than within-seed variance. Topology and graph structure show no association (all |r| < 0.1). High-rawIQR profiles differ from low-rawIQR only in spread metrics (rawStd, rawIQR), not in central tendency or bounds.
purpose: Investigate what generates rawIQR variation between profiles before SelectAndClassify.
primaryQuestion: What generates rawIQR differences between profiles before SAC/P1 assignment?

IsHi pass rates are rawIQR-independent (45-49% across strata)
rawIQR survives seed matching — residual separates P1/P1b

Pooled composite (V5.53) and residual discriminator (V5.54) are different layers

S=0.10 fixed; rawIQR scales with S
